title: Add image embeddings and object detection

context.summary: Add real image embedding and object detection model roles to the image pipeline.
context.background: Image search should work through captions, OCR, labels, detected objects and visual embeddings.

in: Add @mindory/llm contracts and adapters for image embeddings and object detection.
Persist object observations, labels, bounding boxes and image vectors as derived artifacts.
Index image vectors in the selected vector backend.
Search image artifacts by object labels and visual vector similarity.
Remove TASK-98-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Face recognition changes beyond existing face roles.

acceptance_criteria: Image embeddings are generated through @mindory/llm and persisted as derived state.
Object detection results include labels, confidence and optional bounding boxes.
Unified search can return image object and image-vector results with source refs.
Image embedding/object detection tests use a real fake-compatible provider.

manual_checks: Confirm raw image originals are not modified.

risks: Vector dimension compatibility must be validated per configured image embedding model.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
